title: The Dirt Beneath the Devil #4
desc: The survivors finally arrive at Buckley Ranch, where William Buckley's final wishes are revealed... And with them, the horrifying truth behind the fortune that has left so many dead. As old sins ignite into an inferno of vengeance, greed, and supernatural terror, June must confront the dark covenant that binds her family to the land itself. Some inheritances are worth killing for. Others should have remained buried forever.
